run_ids_comment: Up to 20 run ids. Filled by tools/judging_json.py from the result records in S3; empty until the runs exist. Planned slots (PLAN v5.1, section 8):
1 t3 deny: 27/27 denied, each with a Cedar decision record
2 t3 allow: 14/14 allowed and applied, each approved by a person
3 t3 pause: calls refused while paused, allowed after resume
4 t3 rebuilt trace: one trace id rebuilt from CloudWatch, with no Gateway bypass
5 t3 swarm incident eval: masked-tier gain over config_revert, CI lower bound above 0; all four baselines reported
16 t1 RL train and evaluate (hosted twin)
19 ladder, healthy (R1 and R2 gains, settings shift)
20 Viavi R3 retention (only with a machine credential) or the live grounding demo
